tasks.label: setup:env
tasks.command: node -e 'const fs=require(`fs`);if(!fs.existsSync(`.env`)){fs.copyFileSync(`.env.example`,`.env`);console.error(`Created .env from .env.example - fill in the values (see README > Environment) and re-run Setup.`);process.exit(1)}if(/your_/.test(fs.readFileSync(`.env`,`utf8`))){console.error(`.env still contains placeholder values (your_...) - see README > Environment.`);process.exit(1)}console.log(`.env OK`)'

tasks.label: setup:google-services
tasks.command: node -e 'if(!require(`fs`).existsSync(`support/google-services.json`)){console.error(`Missing support/google-services.json - download it from Firebase Console > Project settings > Android app com.ledsav.fitsnapshot (see README > Environment).`);process.exit(1)}console.log(`support/google-services.json OK`)'
